about.title: About me
about.p1: Hey, I’m Ara. I’ve always been curious about how things work and how an idea can turn into something meaningful. I love creating, experimenting and learning along the way.
about.p2: I don’t have everything figured out, but I enjoy the process of growing, making mistakes and getting better at what I do. Trying something new, seeing what works and starting again is part of what keeps me interested.
about.p3: I believe the little details make a big difference, and I try to bring that mindset into everything I create. This website is a small reflection of who I am, what I’m passionate about and where I’m headed.
